close_reason: MemoryBackend.create_object now replaces 'placeholder-blob' with a UUID; test asserts blobId is not the placeholder
description: build_email_from_create sets blob_id=Id::from("placeholder-blob") with a doc comment saying 'the backend assigns the real blobId in create_object'. MemoryBackend does NOT do this — it stores and returns whatever blob_id is in the obj. So Email/set create responses from MemoryBackend echo blobId:"placeholder-blob" to clients. This is both a correctness bug in MemoryBackend and a documentation trap for backend implementors who will follow this pattern. The MailBackend trait gives no indication that create_object must replace the placeholder. Risk: any backend that models itself on MemoryBackend returns a garbage blobId.
title: MemoryBackend (reference impl) returns 'placeholder-blob' as blobId after Email/set create
